references.title: DWDS: Weihnachten
references.supports: Substantiv (Neutrum), no Wortzerlegung, only 'formal verwandt mit Weihnacht'; Etymologie: the Nominative plural mhd. wīhenachten, formed from the dative plural ze den wīhen nahten, used as a singular since the 14th century

references.title: DWDS: Weihnacht
references.supports: The Wortzerlegung weihen Nacht, for the feminine Weihnacht, not for Weihnachten

references.title: en.wiktionary: Weihnachten
references.supports: German etymology: inherited from MHG wīhenahten, from the dative plural ze den wīhen nahten; 'Compare modern weihen and Nacht'

notes.rationale: DWDS gives Weihnachten no Wortzerlegung, only a formal link to Weihnacht, and en.wiktionary calls it inherited from a Middle High German phrase, so no German bracketing exists and it is a bottom word (ADR 0050's tie rule). Its en is no ending today: the genitive is Weihnachtens. So the Root weihnachten and the zero ending (ADR 0051).
